Plugin.Name: unMotion
Plugin.Overview: Clone VMs locally, move them between paired Unraid hosts, or maintain scheduled ZFS replicas with guarded manual recovery. Cold and Warm Move support ZFS and sparse files; Warm Move shuts down for final cutover. Live migration copies eligible running file/zvol guests with a handover pause, CPU compatibility preparation and optional experimental software TPM 2.0. Both live peers need matching 0.5.0 and the reviewed virtualization stack; passthrough and other unsupported layouts remain blocked. Native payload transport uses pinned SSH with disposable job-restricted keys and exact session cleanup. Review retained-copy cleanup, replica retirement/recreation, progress and diagnostic reports in the web GUI. Recovery requires dedicated ZFS storage, eligible Guest Agent evidence and a reachable, stopped, fenced source; unauthorized native starts are rejected before QEMU. No automatic failover or unreachable-source recovery. Requires Unraid 7.3.2 or later. Keep verified backups and follow the setup and coordinated upgrade guide.
